tagline: Tools for the work of keeping spaces clean.
eyebrow: Brooms, mops, brushes and cleaning systems

story.title: Utility first. A full cleaning system follows.
story.body: Clean Matic’s online store presents a broad family of brooms, mops, brushes, squeegees, sponges, mats, dustpans, bins and supporting tools. The brand highlights more than three decades of supply, wholesale partnerships and physical store presence in Tangerang Selatan.

highlights.title: Complete cleaning range
highlights.body: From brooms and mops to bins and support tools, the catalogue covers everyday cleaning workflows.

highlights.title: Replaceable + practical
highlights.body: Product descriptions emphasize durable parts, refillability and efficient household use.

highlights.title: Retail + wholesale
highlights.body: The brand serves home users while actively inviting distributors, resellers and stores.

highlights.title: Tangsel presence
highlights.body: Clean Matic lists a Taman Tekno BSD store, making the brand locally relevant to the Tangsel showcase.
